measurement_script:
"""Restoration-validator cost comparison; no game or timing certification."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import platform
import statistics
import subprocess
import time
import types
from pathlib import Path

from tests.psychic_modifier_helpers import pending_request
from tests.retained_attack_helpers import pending_retained_attack
from warhammer40k_core.engine.active_player_scope_history import validate_active_player_history
from warhammer40k_core.engine.damage_allocation import DestructionReactionKind

BASE = '57957112dbb65596d99e44e8e97649b4abdb75c1'
SOURCE = 'src/warhammer40k_core/engine/active_player_scope_history.py'
base_source = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'{BASE}:{SOURCE}'])
base_module = types.ModuleType('r36_001_base_history')
exec(compile(base_source, '<r36-001-base-history>', 'exec'), base_module.__dict__)
started = time.perf_counter()
session, _ = pending_retained_attack(reaction_kind=DestructionReactionKind.SHOOT_ON_DEATH)
request = pending_request(session)
option = next(option for option in request.options
              if isinstance(option.payload, dict) and option.payload.get('action') == 'shoot')
session.submit_option(request_id=request.request_id, result_id='r36-001-benchmark-shoot',
                      option_id=option.option_id)
state = session.lifecycle.state
assert state is not None and len(state.active_player_scopes) == 1
decisions = session.lifecycle.decision_controller
prepared = time.perf_counter()
rows = {'base': [], 'head': []}
functions = {'base': base_module.validate_active_player_history,
             'head': validate_active_player_history}
for function in functions.values():
    function(state=state, decisions=decisions)
for sample in range(7):
    for name in ('base', 'head') if sample % 2 == 0 else ('head', 'base'):
        function = functions[name]
        start = time.perf_counter()
        for _ in range(100):
            function(state=state, decisions=decisions)
        rows[name].append((time.perf_counter() - start) / 100)
report = {
    'workload_id': 'r36-001-retained-shooting-scope-restoration-v1',
    'base_commit': BASE,
    'scope': 'Only validate_active_player_history, on the same real retained-shooting state and history; module-isolated base uses unchanged dependencies. Not full lifecycle restore or full-game certification.',
    'method': '7 alternating base/head batches of 100 calls after one warmup each; serial, no test workers, coverage or profiling; construction excluded.',
    'setup_seconds': prepared - started,
    'platform': platform.platform(), 'python': platform.python_version(),
    'cpu': subprocess.check_output(['sysctl', '-n', 'machdep.cpu.brand_string'], text=True).strip(),
    'memory_bytes': int(subprocess.check_output(['sysctl', '-n', 'hw.memsize'], text=True)),
    'hardware_status': 'provisional local host',
    'event_count': len(decisions.event_log.records), 'decision_count': len(decisions.records),
    'scope_kinds': [scope.kind.value for scope in state.active_player_scopes],
    'state_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(state.to_payload(), sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    'history_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(decisions.to_payload(), sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
    'base_source_sha256': hashlib.sha256(base_source).hexdigest(),
    'hashes': {name: hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in
               [SOURCE, 'uv.lock', 'src/warhammer40k_core/_engine_build_manifest.json',
                'tests/retained_attack_helpers.py']},
    'measurement_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'results': {name: {'seconds_per_call': values, 'mean_seconds': statistics.mean(values),
                       'median_seconds': statistics.median(values),
                       'p95_batch_mean_seconds': sorted(values)[math.ceil(len(values)*0.95)-1],
                       'maximum_batch_mean_seconds': max(values), 'completion_rate': 1.0,
                       'calls_per_second': 1/statistics.mean(values)}
                for name, values in rows.items()},
    'full_game_certified': False,
}
Path('docs/performance/order36/r36-001-restoration.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report['results'], indent=2))
